RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor and nine City Council members are elected. Seven council members represent districts, and two are elected at-large (Positions 8 and 9). The City Attorney and Municipal Judges are also elected officials. Information on City Council members was primarily sourced from the official seattle.gov website's 'Elected Officials' and 'City Council' pages, which are considered the most current.
